_about: Universal substance table, read by the chemistry archetype files ONLY (never by the tutor shell). One record per substance. Every numeric field carries its source and date under `source`. Fields are optional: an archetype asks for what it needs and fails loudly if it is missing. Convention for dHvap: at the normal boiling point. Future fields (instructor to supply): molar_mass_g_mol, density_g_mL (with temperature), Kf_K_kg_mol, Kb_K_kg_mol, dHfus_kJ_mol. Each archetype keeps its own range choices (e.g. the coldest temperature a problem uses) in its own file; those are teaching parameters, not data.

fields.dHvap_at_Tb_kJ_mol: enthalpy of vaporization AT THE NORMAL BOILING POINT, kJ/mol
